QuestInfo.name: [Kao's Memory] The Sixth Memory
QuestInfo.0: A worrisome Dimensional Crack has formed somewhere in Esfera, the Origin Sea. A familiar aura emanates from inside...
QuestInfo.2: Kao's memory flowed in when you placed your hand on the crack. This memory seems to be the last one in Esfera.
QuestInfo.1: You hear something familiar from beyond the Dimensional Crack...
